# Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital is one of Denmark's largest treatment centers for inflammatory bowel disease, serving patients enrolled in the DANIBD registry—a national database tracking care and outcomes for individuals with Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis [^src1].

As of the registry period October 2023 to September 2024, the hospital managed 1,150 patients undergoing biologic drug treatment (BMSL), of whom 804 patients (70%) had Crohn's disease and 342 patients (30%) had ulcerative colitis [^src1]. These figures place Sjællands Universitetshospital among the largest biologic treatment programs in Denmark for inflammatory bowel disease, reflecting its role as a major referral and treatment center within the Danish healthcare system.

The hospital's patient cohort documented in the DANIBD registry encompasses detailed clinical characterization, including treatment patterns, surgical interventions, and comorbid conditions such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC). The data collected at Sjællands Universitetshospital contributes to the national understanding of biologic medication efficacy, disease management, and surgical patterns across both adult and pediatric inflammatory bowel disease populations [^src1].
